repairs.D1_tensor_control: build_PN_fiberfirst rebuilt with stride 6 (index 6j+i); Tensor_convention now verifies an independent kronecker_product assembly, the exact flip identity F = J P[N] J*, permuted attainment F(Jx) = 2(Jy), and the unpermuted mismatch F x != 2 y; the two conventions are equivalent under J, neither is intrinsically wrong
repairs.D2_word_generation: words_upto parameterized by the actual N and N*, cache removed; cyclicity and unital *-algebra dimension reported as separate structured fields; zero-matrix and reducible-nonzero controls added; independent rationalized 36-word-basis determinant certificate added
repairs.S1_psd_hermiticity_guard: psd_hermitian verifies Hermiticity exactly before the principal-minor test
repairs.S2_no_exception_failures: expected-fail certificates must fail by comparison_mismatch; any exception marks the mutant inconsistent

ReN_blocks.detail: Hermitian part (N+N*)/2, reordered (1,3,5|2,4,6), has zero diagonal blocks and off-diagonal blocks C, C* equal to the displayed C

Tensor_convention.detail: true fiber-first sum_k C_k (x) N^k (stride 6) matches an independent kronecker_product assembly, equals J P[N] J*, attains F(Jx)=2(Jy) with permuted vectors, and gives a nonzero residual (norm^2 = 2099/512 - 129*sqrt(14)/256) against the unpermuted base-first vectors; F != P[N]

PNx_2y.detail: P[N] x = 2 y exactly with ||x|| = ||y|| = 1, x = (e3 f1 + e6 f2)/sqrt2, y = (e1 f1 + ell f2)/sqrt2

Schmidt.detail: x and y have both Schmidt coefficients 1/sqrt2 (XX* fiber Grams equal I/2)

Grading.detail: grade dimensions [(0, 1), (1, 3), (2, 4), (3, 3), (4, 1)]; every nonzero entry of P[N] maps grade g to g+2

B_block.detail: grade 1 -> grade 3 block B (inputs e3f1,e5f1,e6f2; outputs e1f1,e2f2,e4f2) equals the displayed B, including its explicit zeros

BBstar.detail: B*B (1,0,1)/sqrt2 = 4 (1,0,1)/sqrt2; on the orthogonal complement B*B = [[67/64, 33sqrt7/128],[33sqrt7/128, 301/256]]; complementary trace 569/256, det 49/64; eigenvalues 4, (569+-33sqrt113)/512; the latter two lie below 337/128 since 33^2*113 = 123057 < 606841 = 779^2

Outer_blocks.detail: grade-0 column norm^2 = 337/128; grade-2 -> grade-4 block is rank one with squared norm 337/128; grade-3 and grade-4 input columns of P[N] vanish

Charpoly.detail: full 12x12 characteristic polynomial of P[N]*P[N], computed directly, equals t^7 (t-4)(t-337/128)^2(t^2-569t/256+49/64) (so the squared singular values are exactly 4, 337/128, 337/128, (569+-33sqrt113)/512, with 7 zeros)

The universal quantifier in the scalar-channel bound for every complex unit u, v.  Universal scalar compression is NOT proved by the 36 exact samples: they are only sampled instances.  The universal argument rests on the analytic source reasoning (flat Schmidt coefficients giving product overlap <= 1/2, the exact complementary bound 337/128, and output contraction); only those finite ingredients were verified here.
The convexity step from constant support-pencil spectrum to W(N) = closed unit disk (the pencil spectrum itself was verified symbolically for all theta) -- an analytic argument, not a finite check.
The equality-case structure claims (rank-four positive boundary field, D inertia (2,2,2), H^(1/2) D H^(1/2) = 0) from the I287 analysis; out of scope for this calibration.
